tool_input.description: Interactive rebase to squash WIP commits

result:
The system is blocking history rewrites on the main branch due to a safety rule (`git.history_rewrite`). This prevents me from running interactive rebases to squash the commits.

To squash the WIP commits into the real change, you'll need to either:
1. Disable the `git.history_rewrite` protection rule in settings, or
2. Run the interactive rebase manually yourself

The command to squash would be:
```bash
git rebase -i 7b0ff28
```

Then mark all the WIP commits as `squash` (or `s`) and keep the real commit (`97a29ad`) as `pick`, which will combine them into a single clean commit with the message "fold: correct sign on reversal (ACME-4412)".
